entries.message: Feature - Keep same-title shows apart, make Up Next sync reliable, and add a Watch-State Aliases repair card
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: A live watch-history restore log now shows its final lines when the restore finishes
Rating changes made directly on Plex, Emby, Jellyfin or Trakt now sync out to every other service instead of being reverted, unless a local edit is genuinely newer
An unchanged rating is no longer re-imported as a remote change on every scan, which had caused redundant writes and reset retry backoff on every service
Plex, Emby and Jellyfin rating conflicts no longer lose to a stale pending local write, which had left Plembfin and the service permanently out of step
Clearing a rating on Jellyfin now takes effect
The rating pill and watchlist and list buttons on a movie, show or episode page reflect your existing data on a fresh direct page load
Plex watchlist sync resolves a common or duplicate title by year and then by the item's real provider ids, so it no longer gets stuck as not available, including two separate Arrival (2016) entries

A same-titled show on one media server can no longer overwrite a show identity correctly resolved from another server, and the playback-progress list no longer picks the wrong show's poster the same way
Clearing progress on an episode no longer comes back as a resume card when a server still reports the old position; the episode stays in Up Next from the start
Shows that share a title but have different TMDB or TVDB ids, such as Scrubs and its 2026 reboot, no longer merge into one Up Next card, appear twice, or overwrite each other's progress
Marking an episode watched now brings in the correct next episode for that show
Emby part-watches reach Up Next even when the episode was once marked unwatched, and Up Next syncing no longer adds a play to Emby's count for the next episode on every run

Up Next syncing no longer removes items from Plex or Emby Continue Watching just because Plembfin's queue does not list them; items leave only when you clear progress or remove them in Plembfin, and the sync message reports how many app-only items were left in place
Clearing progress on an Up Next episode now reaches Trakt instead of failing as not found
An episode listed in a server's Continue Watching with no position shows as the next episode, not a 0% part-watch
Marking an episode unwatched while Up Next is syncing no longer puts it back to watched on Jellyfin, Emby or Plex with its old watch date
Part-watching one version of a Jellyfin episode that has several versions is picked up by the scheduled resume check, and resume cards link to the Jellyfin episode
Starting an episode in Jellyfin no longer counts as marking it unwatched, so a first Jellyfin play of an episode you had unwatched reaches Up Next and your other media servers
Resume progress keeps the IMDb and TMDB ids the media server reported when history only knows the show's TVDB id, and no longer adds a second, empty Part Watched card

A media server that is offline is stood down briefly instead of being retried on every lookup, is skipped by the Up Next push, and no longer causes back-to-back pushes; a push is queued as soon as it answers again
Up Next no longer offers a next episode that has been removed from every library because of an old item id; the id is checked against the libraries first and kept when a server cannot be reached
Clearing progress on, or marking watched, an episode of one show no longer changes the same episode of a same-title show or deletes that show's history entries

The media detail header has a new layout: a facts table for status, genres, network, language and runtime, the release date in the status row, external ratings as logo badges with scores, and ratings anchored beside the progress bar
TV show status reads as Released - date - status

When two Plex shows share a title, Up Next, Watch now and watch sync use the show whose ids match instead of whichever Plex search listed first, and a show Plex titles with a country tag such as The Assembly (UK) gets its Plex Watch now link
An Up Next card that only Emby or Jellyfin lists also carries the Plex item, and refreshing Emby's native Up Next rail no longer moves the previous episode's watch date
Restarting Plembfin while a media server is offline keeps the Up Next cards only that server can confirm, with their Watch now links, until it answers again

Resuming a show you had fully marked unwatched gives its Up Next card its Plex and Emby links again, and a part-watched episode's card carries its Jellyfin item even when Jellyfin does not show it in Next Up
A first watch of an episode is no longer skipped as already watched because a same-title show has a watch at that season and episode
An Up Next card for a show no library holds is no longer linked to a different show with the same name in Jellyfin, Emby or Plex
The dashboard shows a media server's connection-unavailable line within about a minute of it going offline, and the Up Next API response is no longer cached by the browser
A show you cleared no longer comes back as next up because a same-title show has a watch, and marking an episode unwatched no longer unwatches the same episode of a same-title show
Watching one of two same-title shows no longer marks the other show's matching Jellyfin episode watched during scheduled sync
The Upcoming control bar buttons and text match the media action pills, and the poster size slider sits at the front of the Movies and TV Shows control bars in place of the Options menu
Removing, restoring, marking watched or unwatched one same-title show's Up Next card no longer hides, fades or brings back the other show's card, including from a show's page
Dismissing or approving a watch review without provider ids looks up the show from the reporting app, and stays pending instead of guessing when two shows share the title
Refreshing a show's native Up Next rail on Emby or Jellyfin no longer unmarks the previous episode in Plembfin, so Up Next no longer falls back behind an episode you already watched

A later watch can no longer make an earlier unwatched episode read as watched, Recently Watched no longer merges two same-title shows' episodes, and an unwatch no longer retires a same-title show's pending review

Watches Plex, Emby or Jellyfin report only through their watched-library scan are stored under the show's identity with show and episode ids, so they join the show and their reviews match the right show
The Now, release-date and close buttons work in the Mark watched date dialog opened from a dashboard card menu
Browser tabs show the Plembfin logo again, with the white variant on dark browser themes
Marking an episode or movie watched or unwatched on the dashboard refreshes the Up Next rail straight away

Episodes history shows as watched no longer linger in the Manual Watch review list because of an out-of-date watch state, and approving a review records the watch state under the same show as its history entry
Cross-platform match issues counted in the Sync Activity header are listed again with their Fix match and Remove actions
New episodes or movies added to Plex no longer create unwatched history entries or send unwatches to Emby, Jellyfin and Trakt
Duplicate episode watch states are matched to their show through TVDB as well as TMDB, and through the show's own IMDb or TVDB id, so more are cleaned up automatically

Settings > Tools > Database Repairs has a Watch-State Aliases card listing episode watch states the automatic repair could not tie to their show, with the reason for each; Belongs to this show moves them into the show, keeping the newest watch state, and Different show stops them being listed or moved again. Only Plembfin's own watch state changes

Manual Watch review: the sidebar count matches the page for same-title shows, the page no longer reloads repeatedly, and each review names the show its ids prove, with no poster rather than the wrong show's

Manual Watch review season and show actions are one watched and one unwatched button, using the media page's date popup and unwatch confirmation, and say that episodes not waiting for review keep their state
The Dismissed Up Next pop-up uses more of wide screens with six cards per row, dropping to four, three, then one as the window narrows
A Tautulli import skips a play older than the item's newest unwatch, and no longer skips a real episode play as a duplicate of a different episode of the same show
Library imports no longer queue a Manual Watch review for an item already watched, and pending reviews that local state already answers are closed
A part-watched movie stays at the front of Up Next, and stopping something part-way or clearing progress updates an open dashboard without a refresh
Refreshing Up Next with nothing new on Plex, Emby or Jellyfin no longer triggers a needless Up Next sync
When a title alone cannot tell two shows or films apart on Emby or Jellyfin, Plembfin skips that server instead of writing to both, and a title with a year such as Scrubs (2026) finds only that show
